query: Jobs created by the new casinos must deliver livable wages.

commitment.title: Proposed requirement that new casino jobs deliver livable wages
commitment.description: A public statement said that jobs created by new casinos must deliver livable wages to help families live, stay, and prosper in New York.
commitment.original_text: Revenue from new gaming facilities is expected to generate substantial fiscal benefit to New York’s public schools, local governments, and problem gambling treatment services. The jobs created by these casinos must deliver livable wages to help families live, stay, and prosper in New York.

Jobs created by the new casinos deliver livable wages.
Status: UNVERIFIED
The cited passage documents the original commitment/requirement: "The jobs created by these casinos must deliver livable wages." It identifies the actor's stated standard for jobs created by the new casinos in New York.
Promised scope: New York State Gaming Facility Location Board states that jobs created by the new gaming facilities/casinos in New York must deliver livable wages to help families live, stay, and prosper in New York. Intended beneficiaries are the workers/families tied to those jobs; location is New York; benefit is livable wages.
Observed scope: No cited evidence shows any actual workers at any new casino receiving livable wages. No specific casino, employee group, wage level, or location-specific delivery beyond the general New York promise is reported.
Evidence gap: There is no cited delivery evidence showing that jobs at any covered new casino actually paid livable wages, nor any evidence identifying recipients, wage terms, or a specific site where this occurred.
Promise evidence: c1
